summary: Reviewed all four test files added in WP-005: log-resolver.test.ts (isDryRun edge cases), run-log-handlers.test.ts (is_dry_run pass-through), project-detail-runs.test.ts (badge rendering), and run-log.test.ts (dry-run action rendering).

All 6 acceptance criteria are met. Tests are well-organized, follow established file conventions (real filesystem I/O for node-side tests, jsdom+vm for browser-side), and correctly separate concerns — log-resolver.test.ts owns isDryRun logic, handlers test is a thin pass-through confirmation.

The isDryRun section in log-resolver.test.ts covers the key edge cases comprehensively: absent field, explicit false, empty file, malformed JSON, non-run_start first line with dry_run:true. The severity tests in run-log.test.ts deliberately use empty payloads to isolate classification — good pattern.

One minor coverage gap noted: handleListRunLogs dual-source merge integration tests do not include an is_dry_run variant for an orchestratorLogsDir-side dry run. Non-blocking given findRunLogs unit tests own the isDryRun logic.
No blocking issues. No fix-forward changes applied. One documentation-forward comment left for Documentation agent.

comments.note: The handleListRunLogs dual-source merge/deduplication integration tests (same-filename dedup, logsDir precedence, active run from orchestratorLogsDir) don't include an is_dry_run variant. Since is_dry_run flows through findRunLogs and deduplication is filename-based (the winning entry retains its own is_dry_run value), there's no correctness risk — but a single test asserting is_dry_run: true for a dry-run file in orchestratorLogsDir would close the gap. Low priority given the isDryRun unit tests in log-resolver.test.ts are already comprehensive.

[documentation-forward] The isDryRun() function in src/gui/log-resolver.ts has a good JSDoc comment, but the RunLogEntry interface could add a note clarifying that is_dry_run defaults to false for unreadable/malformed/empty files (consistent with the fail-safe behavior documented on isDryRun itself). This would help future contributors understand why the field is always present even for corrupted logs.

No observations beyond the above — tests are clean, consistent with existing file conventions, and well-structured. Search ordering of isDryRun + isRunActive via Promise.all in findRunLogs is correctly mirrored in the tests.
